guides.title: Quick Print Workflow
guides.overview: Quick Print is the "no-frills, one-object, one-well" print workflow. You pick a single object (a built-in shape — Dot, Circle, or Meander-filled disc — or any saved print from the print library), click one well on the plate map, optionally let it auto-prep the needle and pick up ink, then press Print. It builds the same single-well print job the standard Print Setup uses and runs it through a fresh PrintManager in discrete mode, so motion matches the normal print flow. Operators use it for fast single deposits or quick verification prints without going through full Print Setup. By default (Prep ON, Cleanup ON) one press runs the full bioprint sequence: prep the needle (waste -> oil -> wash -> buffer), pick up the print's ink, position over the well (needle retracted), print hands-free, then clean the needle (waste -> wash -> reset oil).
guides.where_to_find: Workflows mode -> Workflow picker -> "Quick Print" tile. Use the "← Back to Workflows" button (top-left) to return to the picker. The full option set lives behind the "⚙ Settings" button in the top-right header.
prerequisites: XY stage AND ZP (Z + pumps) stage both connected — Print stays disabled and the run refuses to start until both report connected.
A plate must be available and calibrated — run Calibration so the page receives well positions (set_calibration_data). The selected well must resolve to a position (calibrated, else geometric).

Safe Z / move height must be set on the Calibration page if Prep, ink pickup, OR post-print cleanup is enabled — any well descent needs it; the run refuses to start without it. A plain print (no prep/ink/cleanup) only shows a 'No Safe Z' continue-anyway prompt.
Plate bottom Z must be calibrated when Prep, ink pickup, or cleanup is on (needed to resolve the ink/service dip heights above the bottom).
For ink pickup: the chosen ink must have a reagent location assigned (Hardware Setup -> Ink) AND that well must be in the calibrated plate map (run Plate Location).

For Prep: the needle inner diameter + length must be set (Hardware Setup -> Needle) so '1 needle' bore volume is known, and all four service wells (waste, oil, wash, buffer) must be assigned and calibrated.
For post-print cleanup: needle geometry set, plus the waste, wash, and oil wells assigned and calibrated.
A microscope camera assigned to the MICROSCOPE role lets the live feed display (otherwise the camera pane shows a 'No camera manager available.' placeholder).

steps.title: Open Quick Print
steps.detail: From Workflows mode, click the Quick Print tile. The page shows: header (← Back to Workflows, title, a live settings summary, ⚙ Settings), an Object/Size row, a setup-status strip, the main area (trajectory monitor + live camera over the well-plate selector), and a run row (Print / Abort + status). The live microscope feed starts on this page.

steps.title: Choose an object
steps.detail: In the Object combo pick a built-in shape (⋅ Dot, ◯ Circle, ◉ Meander (filled disc)) or a saved print listed as '📄 name  (N)' where N is the object count. Use the ⟳ button next to it to rescan config/prints (the list also auto-refreshes each time the page is shown). For Circle and Meander a 'Size' spin appears (0.1–20.00 mm = the radius); Dot and saved prints hide it. The trajectory monitor updates with the planned path.

steps.title: Select the well
steps.detail: Click a well on the well-plate navigator (bottom pane, titled 'Well — click to place the object'). The status line confirms 'Well X selected.' and the planned path re-centers on that well with its boundary circle.

steps.title: Open ⚙ Settings and set print parameters
steps.detail: Click ⚙ Settings (top-right) to open the scrollable popout. In the Print section set Pump/bore, Flow @100% (µL/s), Print speed (% of max), and Height above bottom (mm). The setup-status strip and the header summary update live as you change values.

steps.title: Set ink pickup (optional)
steps.detail: In the Ink pickup section choose the Ink (defaults to the selected pump's assigned ink if it's printable; '(none — needle already loaded)' skips pickup). Set Ink dip Z (height above bottom when aspirating) and the Pickup safety (×) multiplier. The status strip shows 'Ink "X" ← well · pick up ~N µL' or a peach ⚠ if the ink has no reagent location or its well isn't calibrated.

steps.title: Review needle prep + post-print cleanup
steps.detail: Needle prep (default ON) does waste -> oil -> wash -> buffer before ink pickup; set Service dip Z and Wash cycles. Post-print cleanup (default ON) does waste -> wash -> reset oil afterward; set Waste (× needle) and Oil refill fallback. Service dip Z and Wash cycles are shared by prep and cleanup, so they stay enabled regardless of the Prep checkbox. The status strip shows ✓ when service wells map correctly, or a ⚠ listing what to assign/calibrate.

steps.title: Optionally save a settings profile
steps.detail: Use the profile bar at the top of the popout: Save overwrites the selected file (or acts as Save As if none is selected); Save As… names a reusable file; the 'Settings file' combo loads a saved file; Delete removes the selected file after a confirm; Import…/Export… read/write a JSON anywhere; Reset restores factory defaults. The last-used values auto-restore on the next visit. Close with the Close button when done.

steps.title: Read the setup-status strip
steps.detail: Back on the page, the status strip summarizes Print mm/s + µL/s, the ink source and pickup volume, prep mapping, and cleanup plan. Green = a preamble/cleanup is active and ready, peach = a warning/gap to fix, gray subtext = a plain print with no preamble.

steps.title: Press Print and confirm setup
steps.detail: Click Print. If the chosen height is below the calibrated plate bottom you first get a 'Below plate bottom' warning (the needle is clamped, not crashed). If a preamble (prep/ink) OR the post-print cleanup is active you then get a 'Confirm print setup' dialog listing exactly what will run (prep, ink pickup volume + source well, the print, and the cleanup plan). Click Yes to proceed.

steps.title: Let preflight run (hands-free)
steps.detail: On a worker thread the page runs prep (if on), picks up ink (if selected), then travels XY to the print-start point with the needle RETRACTED to safe Z. The live microscope keeps updating. Abort is available during the preamble (but not during a plain preposition with nothing to interrupt). The print then starts automatically — there is no per-print position confirmation. The run is refused if the preamble aborted/errored, the ZP board dropped during positioning, or the positioning move did not confirm arrival.

steps.title: Watch the print + cleanup
steps.detail: The trajectory monitor records the executed path (green) and a fading needle ghost trail over the planned path; the status shows [done/total] steps and the execution log filename (logs/prints/...). On a completed print, if cleanup is on it runs waste -> wash -> reset oil on its own worker thread, then the status confirms 'needle cleaned'. The needle ends retracted out of the well at the travel Z (it does NOT return to 0,0). Use Abort at any time to stop.

settings.name: Object (combo)
settings.what_it_does: Selects what to print: built-in shapes ⋅ Dot, ◯ Circle, ◉ Meander (filled disc), plus every saved print from config/prints shown as '📄 name  (N)' where N is the object count. Drives the planned-path preview and the printed geometry. Inline on the page.
settings.recommendation: Use Dot for a single deposit, Circle/Meander for parametric rings/fills, or a saved print for a designed/imported pattern. Press ⟳ to refresh the saved list.

settings.name: ⟳ Refresh saved prints (button)
settings.what_it_does: Re-scans config/prints and rebuilds the Object list, preserving the current selection. The list also auto-refreshes every time the page is shown.
settings.recommendation: Click after creating a print in Sketch / Image Import / manual import so it appears without restarting.

settings.name: Size (spin)
settings.what_it_does: Radius in mm for the Circle and Meander built-in shapes. Range 0.1–20.00 mm, step 0.5, default 1.00 mm. Hidden for Dot and saved prints (which carry their own geometry). Updates the path preview and pickup-volume estimate.
settings.recommendation: Keep the radius inside the well's needle-safe boundary shown on the trajectory monitor.

settings.name: Pump / bore (combo)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Print) Which pump drives the print and is used for prep/cleanup/ink pickup. Populated from enabled+configured pumps; defaults to P1 if none are configured. Changing it re-defaults the Ink combo to that pump's assigned ink.
settings.recommendation: Pick the pump physically loaded with the print ink.

settings.name: Flow @100% (spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Print) Pump flow in µL/s at 100% print speed. Range 0.0–50.0, step 0.05, 3 decimals. Print speed % scales BOTH the XY traverse and this flow together, so the deposited bead width stays constant regardless of the %.
settings.recommendation: Tune to your ink/needle so the bead width is right; the % only changes overall speed, not bead width. Flow 0 = dry run (no extrusion, and no ink pickup volume computed).

settings.name: Print speed (spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Print) Print speed as a % of the calibrated maximum XY speed. Range 1–100% (0 decimals, step 5). Scales the XY traverse (% × XY max) and the pump flow together. The 100% anchor is the measured top speed from the timing calibration, else the safety-limit max XY speed, else 10 mm/s.
settings.recommendation: Start ~25% and raise as motion/sync allows; lower if the stage can't keep up with the pump.

settings.name: Height above bottom (Print-Z, spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Print) Print height measured up from the calibrated plate bottom. Range 0.0–40.0 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals. 0 = at the plate bottom; larger = higher. Converted to a zero-ref Z via the plate-bottom datum; the controller hard-clamps so it never prints below the bottom.
settings.recommendation: Small positive offset just off the glass. If set below the bottom you get a 'Below plate bottom' confirm; the needle is clamped, not crashed.

settings.name: Ink (combo)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Ink pickup) Which library ink this print uses. Lists '(none — needle already loaded)' plus printable inks (NOT service reagents — filtered by ink_type and by name) that have a reagent location. When an ink is chosen the needle aspirates it from that well before printing.
settings.default: Pump's assigned ink if printable, else '(none)'
settings.recommendation: Leave '(none)' if you pre-loaded the needle. Otherwise pick the print ink; the status strip shows the source well + pickup volume or a ⚠ if it lacks a reagent location or calibrated well.

settings.name: Ink dip Z (↑ bottom, spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Ink pickup) Needle dip height above the plate bottom when aspirating ink. Range 0.0–30.0 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals.
settings.recommendation: Just above the well bottom so the bore is submerged in ink but not jammed on glass.

settings.name: Pickup safety (×, spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Ink pickup) Safety multiplier on the computed ink pickup volume. Range 1.0–10.0, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Pickup = (path-dispensed + pre-flow prime) × this, floored to the prime so even a single-point dot still draws ink.
settings.recommendation: Keep ~1.5; raise if the print runs dry at the end (extra margin), lower to conserve ink.

settings.name: Prep needle (checkbox)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Needle prep) Label 'Prep needle (waste → oil → wash → buffer)'. When ON, before picking up ink it dispenses 1 needle of oil to waste, aspirates fresh oil, washes, then aspirates buffer. Uses the four service wells from Hardware Setup -> Ink. Toggling it refreshes the status/summary.
settings.recommendation: Leave ON for a fresh conditioned needle. Turn OFF only if the needle is already prepped/loaded.

settings.name: Service dip Z (↑ bottom, spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Needle prep) Needle dip height above the plate bottom at the service wells (also used by post-print cleanup, so it stays enabled regardless of the Prep checkbox). Range 0.0–30.0 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals.
settings.recommendation: Just above the well bottom in the service wells.

settings.name: Wash cycles (spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Needle prep) Number of dip-jiggle cycles at the wash well. Range 0–50. Shared with the post-print cleanup wash step.
settings.recommendation: 3 is a good default; increase for stickier inks.

settings.name: Clean needle after print (checkbox)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Post-print cleanup) Label 'Clean needle after print (waste → wash → reset oil)'. When ON, after a COMPLETED print it dispenses a multiple of the needle to waste, washes, then aspirates oil to reset the syringe's oil level (returning the plunger to its pre-run position). Aborted/errored prints skip it.
settings.recommendation: Leave ON to keep the needle clean and reset oil between prints.

settings.name: Waste (× needle, spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Post-print cleanup) How many needle volumes to dispense to waste after the print. Range 0.0–50.0, step 1.0, 1 decimal.
settings.recommendation: 6× clears the bore; reduce only if conserving fluid.

settings.name: Oil refill (× needle, fallback, spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Post-print cleanup) Fallback oil aspirate to reset the syringe when the live pump position is unavailable; normally the plunger simply returns to its pre-run (oil_baseline) position. Range 0.0–50.0, step 1.0, 1 decimal.
settings.recommendation: Leave at 1× — it's only used if the live position can't be read.

settings.name: Travel speed (spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Advanced) XY speed for non-printing travel moves (approach to the well, hops between objects). Range 0.5–100.0 mm/s, step 1.0, 1 decimal. Feeds PrintSettings.travel_speed_mm_s.
settings.recommendation: 10 mm/s is a safe default; raise for faster repositioning.

settings.name: Pre-flow lead-in (spin)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings -> Advanced) The pump runs at the print flow for this long after the confirmed descent to print Z and before the path starts, so a bead is already forming. Range 0.0–5.0 s, step 0.05, 2 decimals. Implemented as the EXTRUDE prime (flow × this time). Default seeded from Hardware Setup -> Pump (Prime time).
settings.default: Hardware Setup pump prime time (else 0.25 s)
settings.recommendation: Keep ~0.25 s; increase if the print start is under-extruded.

settings.name: Locations & Hardware (read-only info panel)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings, bottom) Rebuilt each time the popout is shown. Shows needle geometry (gauge, inner/outer Ø, length, 1-needle bore volume, bore cross-section), each pump's syringe + assigned inks, all ink/reagent locations with calibrated count + color swatch + type[·subtype], the four service-well roles (✓ green = calibrated / yellow = not calibrated / peach = unassigned), calibration heights (calibrated well count, Safe/move Z, plate bottom/top, fast-move, max, replace Z — only those present), and a 'This workflow' section (the selected print ink and its source well).
settings.recommendation: Read this to confirm where every ink/service well is and which heights are calibrated before printing.

settings.name: Settings file (profile combo)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings, profile bar) Lists '(unsaved)' plus saved settings files for Quick Print. Selecting one loads it into all fields (warns on a read failure).
settings.recommendation: Save named profiles per ink/print recipe so you can reload them.

settings.name: Save / Save As… / Delete (buttons)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings, profile bar) Save overwrites the selected file (acts as Save As if none selected); Save As… prompts for a name; Delete removes the selected file after a confirm. Backed by WorkflowSettingsStore; surfaces a warning on save failure.
settings.recommendation: Use Save As… to capture a working configuration; the last-used values also auto-restore via __last__.json.

settings.name: Import… / Export… (buttons)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings, profile bar) Import… loads settings from any JSON on disk; Export… writes the current settings to a JSON file you choose (auto-appends .json). Surfaces a warning dialog on read/write failure.
settings.recommendation: Use to move a configuration between machines or back it up.

settings.name: Reset (button)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings, profile bar) Restores all fields to their factory defaults and sets the profile combo to '(unsaved)'.
settings.recommendation: Use to start clean if settings drift.

settings.name: Close (button)
settings.what_it_does: (Settings, footer) Hides the settings popout. The popout is also auto-hidden when the page is hidden, and the current values are saved as the last-used profile.
settings.recommendation: Close when done; your changes are kept and auto-restored next visit.

settings.name: Print (button)
settings.what_it_does: Starts the run: gating checks -> optional 'Below plate bottom' warning -> optional 'Confirm print setup' dialog -> preflight (prep/ink pickup/preposition on a worker thread) -> hands-free print -> optional cleanup. Disabled unless XY+ZP connected, a well is selected, a plate exists, and an object is chosen, and not while running, positioning, or cleaning.
settings.recommendation: Press once everything is green. If it stays disabled, check connection, well selection, and object choice.

settings.name: Abort (button)
settings.what_it_does: Stops the active stage: during the preamble it sets the executor abort flag (and a sticky request so the print won't start), otherwise it aborts the PrintManager. Enabled during a print AND during the preflight preamble/cleanup when there's an active executor to interrupt; a plain preposition (no preamble) has nothing to abort.
settings.recommendation: Use to safely stop; the needle is left retracted at safe Z on any abort.

safety_notes: Print is gated off until BOTH the XY and ZP stages report connected; if the ZP board drops during positioning the print is refused (it re-checks is_zp_connected) so it can't dry-run with the needle parked down.

Any well descent (prep, ink pickup, post-print cleanup) requires a Safe Z set on the Calibration page; the run refuses to start without it and tells you to set it or disable Prep/ink/cleanup. A plain print only shows a 'No Safe Z' continue-anyway prompt.

The print height is measured up from the calibrated plate bottom; the controller hard-clamps so a height below the bottom does NOT crash the needle — you get a 'Below plate bottom' warning and the needle is clamped to the bottom, not driven deeper.

When no Safe Z is calibrated the page never falls back to a raw literal travel Z (which would be a DESCENT on ME3B V1 where Z increases downward) — it derives a polarity-safe travel height 10 mm above the print Z.

Pre-positioning travels XY with the needle RETRACTED to safe Z (safe_travel_to with target_z_mm=None: raise -> wait -> XY -> wait, never lowers). It runs on a worker thread so the live feed keeps painting.
Hands-free safety: with no per-print position confirm, the print is refused if the positioning move did not confirm arrival (timeout/unsettled stage) — the needle stays at safe Z.

On any preamble abort/error the worker's finally retracts the needle to safe Z (executor._retract_to_safe_z) before bailing out, and the print does not start. An Abort requested during a blocking pump/travel move is honored via a sticky flag so the print still won't launch.
The print ends by retracting out of the well to the travel Z and stopping where it finished (return_home=False) — it does NOT drive the stage back to XY 0,0.
Multi-object saved prints get one PRINT_PATH per object with a lift -> travel -> lower between them, so the needle does not extrude across seams or drag through already-printed material.

Aborted or errored prints skip the post-print cleanup; the print's own finally has already left the needle at safe Z. Cleanup is also skipped (with a status note) if the ZP board is disconnected at completion, and the cleanup worker always retracts to safe Z on exit.
tips: The header summary line (pump · flow µL/s @ % · ink · prep on/off) and the setup-status strip update live — green means a preamble/cleanup is active and ready, peach flags a gap to fix before printing.
Print speed % is a single master lever: it scales XY traverse and pump flow together so bead width is constant — change it freely to speed up/slow down without re-tuning Flow.

Leave Ink at '(none — needle already loaded)' if you pre-loaded the needle; the run then skips ink pickup. With Prep also off and Cleanup off, it behaves as a plain legacy print (no preamble, no confirm dialog).
Use the read-only Locations & Hardware panel in the popout to confirm service-well calibration (✓/yellow/peach) and all reference heights before a run.
The trajectory monitor shows the planned path, a green executed trace, the well boundary, and a fading needle ghost trail — handy for verifying the path lands inside the well's needle-safe zone.
Saved settings auto-restore each visit; save named profiles per recipe so you can reload pump/flow/ink/prep combinations quickly.
The status line reports the execution log filename (logs/prints/...) — useful for diagnosing a run afterward.

guides.title: Cell Targeting & Removal Workflow
guides.overview: Cell Targeting & Removal trypsinizes cells in place and then extracts and relocates them. For each picked removal location, the needle loads a cell-release reagent (e.g. trypsin) from its reagent well, travels to the cell just off the plate bottom, SLOWLY pushes in a tiny reagent column (needle inner cross-section area x push depth), waits an incubation dwell, then QUICKLY pulls up a multiple of that volume (reagent + released cells), travels to a paired placement location and gently dispenses. An operator uses this to micro-trypsinize specific cells/colonies under the microscope and move them to a new well or spot, with optional standard needle prep before and clean-up after the run. Each removal must be paired one-to-one with a placement target (pick count must equal place count) for Start to enable.
guides.where_to_find: Workflows mode -> Workflow picker -> "Cell Targeting & Removal" tile. The page opens with the Live target picker on the left and an "XY Workspace" view (top) + "Side View (XZ)" view (bottom) on the right. The header shows Back, the title, the hint "Pick = removal location(s) . Place = placement(s)", a one-line settings summary, a "Fluorescence" checkbox, and a "Settings" gear button (far right) that opens the full saveable settings popout.
prerequisites: Hardware Setup complete: XY stage connected AND the ZP (Z + pump) board connected. Cell removal refuses to start without ZP because it needs to retract the needle and run the pumps. Click-to-travel in the XY Workspace also requires the XY stage connected.
A Safe Z height set on the Calibration page (Start refuses without it; click-to-travel will prompt/warn if it is missing).

Plate bottom Z calibrated on the Calibration page so the removal / place / reagent-dip / service-dip heights (all expressed as a height above the plate bottom) can be resolved. If it is uncalibrated the run is blocked.
Plate Location run so wells have calibrated XY positions (needed for the reagent well, and for the four service wells if prep/clean is on).

Needle inner diameter set (Hardware Setup -> Needle): the push volume = needle inner cross-section area x push depth, so a missing/zero bore area gives a non-positive push volume and blocks Start. Needle inner diameter + length are also needed for the '1 needle' prep/clean volume.

A cell-release reagent (e.g. trypsin) defined in the Ink library, assigned to a reagent location (Hardware Setup -> Ink -> Reagent Locations), and that well calibrated by Plate Location. (Optional: you may choose '(none - needle already loaded)' to skip the reagent load.)
If prep/clean is enabled: oil, wash, waste, and buffer reagents assigned to wells and calibrated.
Microscope camera + objective calibrated (um/px) so live-view clicks map to correct stage positions (the picker header shows the effective um/px).

steps.title: Open the page and the Settings popout
steps.detail: From the Workflows picker open the Cell Targeting & Removal tile. Click the 'Settings' gear button in the header to open the scrollable, saveable settings popout where the reagent, push/pull, dwell, speeds, heights and prep/clean are configured. The header shows a one-line summary that reads like 'push X/pull Y uL . dwell Zs . prep on/off'.

steps.title: Choose the bore and cell-release reagent
steps.detail: In Settings -> 'Pump & cell-release reagent', pick the Pump/bore that holds the reagent, then choose the Cell-release reagent. The combo lists library inks that have a reagent location and are NOT service reagents (not wash/waste/buffer/oil, by ink type or by name); it defaults to the bore's assigned ink. There is also a '(none - needle already loaded)' option. Confirm the green status: '✓ Reagent "X" <- well Y . load ~Z uL on the P1 bore'. A peach warning means no reagent selected, no reagent location, or the well is not in the calibrated plate.

steps.title: Set push / pull mechanics and dwell
steps.detail: In 'Reagent push / pull' set Push depth (column = needle inner area x depth), Pull (x) multiplier, Dwell (incubation) time, Push flow (slow) and Pull flow (fast). Watch the readout 'push X uL . pull Y uL' (4 decimals) update. If it shows 'V = - (set needle inner Ø)', set the needle in Hardware Setup -> Needle.

steps.title: Set the heights
steps.detail: In 'Removal & placement heights' set Removal Z (height above plate bottom at the cell, default 0.10 mm - just off the glass) and Place Z (height when dispensing, default 0.50 mm). In 'Pump & cell-release reagent' set Reagent dip Z (when aspirating reagent). If using prep/clean also set Service dip Z. All are heights above the calibrated plate bottom and resolved polarity-safely; if plate bottom is uncalibrated the run is blocked.

steps.title: Configure needle prep / clean (optional)
steps.detail: Leave 'Prep needle (waste -> oil -> wash -> buffer)' and 'Clean after (waste -> wash -> buffer)' checked (both default ON) to condition the needle once before the loop and clean once after. Tune Prep/clean flow, Oil/Buffer needles, Wash cycles + Z/XY jiggle + settle, and Clean dispense. The prep status turns green ('✓ 1 needle = X uL . oil=.. wash=.. waste=.. buffer=..') once the needle volume and all four service wells are assigned and calibrated. Turning BOTH off makes the run 'removal only' and disables the prep/clean sub-fields.

steps.title: Pick the removal locations
steps.detail: In the Live target picker, set the 'Click adds to:' radio to Pick. Left-click each cell/colony to remove - each becomes a green P001, P002... marker. Right-click near a marker (within ~250 um) to remove the nearest one, or use 'Remove selected' / 'Clear all' in the Pick targets list.

steps.title: Pick the placement locations (one per removal)
steps.detail: Switch the 'Click adds to:' radio to Place and left-click each destination - mauve D001, D002... markers appear, joined to their paired pick by a dashed connector (P001->D001 by index). The pairing status must read '✓ N pick->place pair(s) ready.' (green). If counts differ it warns 'N pick(s) / M place(s) - counts must match.' (peach) and Start stays disabled.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.detail: Click 'Start cell removal'. The button only enables when pairs are balanced (>=1 pair, equal counts), a bore exists, and no run is active. On click the page also gates on Safe Z set, ZP connected, resolved plate-bottom heights (removal/place/reagent-dip + service-dip if prep/clean), a positive push volume (needle inner Ø set), a reagent with a calibrated well + dip Z, and - when prep/clean is on - the needle volume + the four service wells (waste/oil/wash/buffer) assigned and calibrated. If any gate fails the status line states exactly what to fix.

steps.title: Monitor and finish
steps.detail: Prep runs once first (if enabled). For each pair the executor loads reagent, travels to the removal target and lowers to Removal Z, slow-pushes, incubates the dwell, fast-pulls, travels to the placement and lowers to Place Z, then gently dispenses. Clean runs once after the loop (if enabled). The status shows per-region sub-steps and a [done/total] progress line. 'Abort' requests a cooperative stop. On any exit (done/abort/error) the needle is always raised to Safe Z; the status ends 'Done.' or 'Stopped (aborted or failed).'

settings.name: 'Click adds to: Pick / Place' radio (live picker)
settings.what_it_does: Two radio buttons that route the next left-click in the live view into the Pick list (green removal targets P001...) or the Place list (mauve placement targets D001...). Right-click removes the nearest target in the active list within ~250 um.
settings.recommendation: Pick all removal cells first, then switch to Place and add one destination per pick.

settings.name: Pick targets list + 'Clear all' / 'Remove selected'
settings.what_it_does: Lists each removal target as 'P00n -> D00n (x, y)' in absolute stage um. 'Clear all' empties the picks (resets numbering to P001); 'Remove selected' deletes highlighted rows.
settings.recommendation: Use right-click on the feed for quick single removals; list buttons for bulk edits.

settings.name: Place targets list + 'Clear all' / 'Remove selected'
settings.what_it_does: Lists each placement target as 'P00n -> D00n (x, y)' in absolute stage um, with the same clear/remove controls. Pairing is by index; counts must equal the picks to enable Start.
settings.recommendation: Keep place count equal to pick count - the pairing banner only turns green when balanced.

settings.name: Pairing status banner (live picker)
settings.what_it_does: Read-only status: 'No targets yet.', '✓ N pick->place pair(s) ready.' (green when balanced), or '⚠ N pick(s) / M place(s) - counts must match. Each pick needs its own place.' (peach).
settings.recommendation: Wait for the green message before clicking Start.

settings.name: um/px readout (live picker header)
settings.what_it_does: Shows the effective microscope um/px used to map clicks to stage um, rescaled to the live frame width (shows 'cal X@W -> live Wpx' when the calibration and live resolutions differ).
settings.recommendation: If it reads '—', calibrate the objective so clicks land accurately.

settings.name: Fluorescence checkbox (header)
settings.what_it_does: Overlays the captured fluorescence mosaic(s) for this plate (from the Fluorescence Mosaic workflow) on the XY Workspace. If none exists it auto-unchecks and the status explains to run that workflow first.
settings.recommendation: Turn on to locate fluorescently-labeled cells before picking removal spots.

settings.name: Settings gear button (header)
settings.what_it_does: Opens the full, scrollable, saveable settings popout (heights, reagent, push/pull, dwell, speeds, prep/clean, motion, locations). It is a modeless child that hides when the page is hidden.
settings.recommendation: Save a named profile per protocol so you can reload exact push/pull/dwell settings later.

settings.name: Start cell removal (run row)
settings.what_it_does: Builds one operation per pick->place pair and runs the queue on a worker thread. Enabled only when pairs are balanced, a bore exists, and no run is active; on click it re-checks all safety/calibration gates and reports the first missing item in the status line.
settings.recommendation: If Start seems to do nothing, read the status line - it names the exact unmet condition.

settings.name: Abort (run row)
settings.what_it_does: Sets the executor abort flag for a cooperative stop; the run finishes the current safe step, retracts to Safe Z, and reports 'Stopped (aborted or failed).' Enabled only while running.
settings.recommendation: Use to safely halt; the needle still ends at Safe Z.

settings.name: XY Workspace view (right, top)
settings.what_it_does: Top-down plate/needle view showing calibrated wells, current stage position, and pick (green) / place (mauve) overlays. Left-click = click-to-travel (always retracts via safe_travel_to when Safe Z is known, target_z None = stays retracted); right-click = 'Fast travel here' (retract Z, travel XY, restore the current Z). Prompts/warns if no Safe Z. Requires the XY stage connected.
settings.recommendation: Use click-to-travel to verify a target before running; it never lowers the needle at a new XY without retracting first.

settings.name: Side View (XZ) + Z-reference 'Go to' badges (right, bottom)
settings.what_it_does: Side profile of needle height vs. plate, showing Safe Z and the Z-reference heights (replace/max/fast-move/plate-top/plate-bottom). Clicking a Z badge issues move_z_absolute to that zero-ref Z (no-op if ZP disconnected).
settings.recommendation: Use the Safe badge to retract Z manually while setting up.

settings.name: Removal Z (↑ bottom) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Needle height above the plate bottom at the cell-removal location. Range 0.0-20.0 mm, 2 decimals, 0.05 step. Maps to CellRemovalConfig.removal_z_offset_mm (executor pick_z_mm).
settings.recommendation: Keep small (just off the glass) so the reagent column lands on the cells.

settings.name: Place Z (↑ bottom) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Needle height above the plate bottom when dispensing extracted cells. Range 0.0-20.0 mm, 2 decimals, 0.05 step. Maps to place_z_offset_mm (executor place_z_mm).
settings.recommendation: Slightly higher than removal Z so the droplet releases cleanly.

settings.name: Pump / bore [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Selects which pump/bore (P1, P2...) holds and dispenses the reagent. Populated from enabled + configured pumps (falls back to P1). Maps to CellRemovalConfig.reagent_bore and the prep_bore.
settings.recommendation: Match the bore that physically carries the trypsin/reagent line.

settings.name: Cell-release reagent [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: The reagent the needle loads (e.g. trypsin). Lists library inks that have a reagent location and are NOT service reagents. Defaults to the bore's assigned ink; '(none - needle already loaded)' skips the reagent load. Status shows resolved well + load volume (green), or a peach warning if no reagent / no location / well not calibrated.
settings.recommendation: Required for Start unless you intentionally choose '(none - needle already loaded)'; confirm the green status before running.

settings.name: Reagent dip Z (↑ bottom) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Needle dip height above the plate bottom when aspirating reagent at its well. Range 0.0-30.0 mm, 2 decimals, 0.1 step. Resolved to a zero-ref Z (executor reagent_dip_z_mm).
settings.recommendation: Deep enough to reach the reagent fluid without touching the well bottom.

settings.name: Push depth [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Reagent column pushed in = needle inner cross-section area x this depth (mm^3 = uL). Range 0.001-5.0 mm, 3 decimals, 0.05 step. Drives the live push uL readout and release_depth_mm/release_volume_uL.
settings.recommendation: A small column relative to the bore; increase only if more reagent is needed to release the cells.

settings.name: Pull (×) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Extraction pull volume = this multiple of the pushed volume (reagent + released cells). Range 1.0-20.0, 2 decimals, 0.5 step. Maps to extract_multiplier.
settings.recommendation: ~2x recovers reagent plus released cells without grabbing too much surrounding fluid.

settings.name: Dwell (incubation) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Incubation time the reagent dwells at the cell before extraction. Range 0-3600 s, 0 decimals, 5 s step. Maps to dwell_time_s; the run blocks at the cell for this time per region.
settings.recommendation: Set to your trypsinization time for the cell line.

settings.name: Push flow (slow) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Slow flow rate to push reagent in (and the gentle final dispense). Range 0.01-50.0 uL/s, 2 decimals, 0.1 step. Maps to push_speed_uL_s.
settings.recommendation: Keep slow so the reagent is delivered gently onto the cells.

settings.name: Pull flow (fast) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Fast flow rate to pull released cells up. Range 0.01-50.0 uL/s, 2 decimals, 0.5 step. Maps to pull_speed_uL_s.
settings.recommendation: Fast so detached cells are drawn up before they resettle.

settings.name: Prep needle (waste -> oil -> wash -> buffer) checkbox [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: When checked, runs standard needle conditioning ONCE before the loop: dispense oil to waste, draw oil, wash, draw buffer. Enables the prep/clean sub-fields and requires the four service wells + needle volume at Start.
settings.recommendation: Leave on for a clean needle; turn off (with clean off) for a quick removal-only run.

settings.name: Clean after (waste -> wash -> buffer) checkbox [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: When checked, runs needle clean-up ONCE after the loop: dispense residual to waste, wash, draw buffer. Also enables the prep/clean sub-fields and contributes to the service-well requirement.
settings.recommendation: Leave on to clean residual reagent/cells out of the needle after the run.

settings.name: Service dip Z (↑ bottom) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Needle dip height above plate bottom at the service wells (waste/oil/wash/buffer). Range 0.0-30.0 mm, 2 decimals, 0.1 step. Enabled only when prep or clean is on (executor service_z_mm).
settings.recommendation: Deep enough to reach fluid in the service wells.

settings.name: Prep / clean flow [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Aspirate/dispense flow rate during prep and clean. Range 0.01-50.0 uL/s, 2 decimals, 0.1 step (executor prep_rate_uL_s). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Moderate flow; slow it down for viscous or shear-sensitive reagents.

settings.name: Oil (needles) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Number of needle-volumes of oil dispensed to waste / aspirated from oil during prep. Range 0.0-20.0, 1 decimal, 0.5 step (executor oil_needles). '1 needle' = needle inner area x length. Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Default 1 needle is usually enough to refresh the oil bracket.

settings.name: Buffer (needles) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Number of needle-volumes of buffer drawn after the wash during prep. Range 0.0-20.0, 1 decimal, 0.5 step (executor buffer_needles). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Default 4 needles fills the line with buffer ahead of the run.

settings.name: Wash cycles [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Number of dip-jiggle cycles at the wash well during prep/clean. Integer 0-50 (executor wash_cycles). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: More cycles = more thorough wash; 3 is a reasonable default.

settings.name: Wash Z jiggle [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: How far up/down each wash jiggle moves. Range 0.0-10.0 mm, 2 decimals, 0.1 step (executor wash_z_amplitude_mm). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Keep within the wash well depth so the tip stays submerged.

settings.name: Wash XY jiggle [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Random XY radius about the wash well centre during the wash. Range 0.0-5000.0 um, 0 decimals, 10 um step (executor wash_xy_amplitude_um). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Keep well inside the wash well so the tip never hits the wall.

settings.name: Wash settle [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Settle time between wash jiggles. Range 0.0-30.0 s, 2 decimals, 0.1 step (executor wash_dwell_s). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Short settle is fine; increase for more agitation time.

settings.name: Clean dispense (needles) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Number of needle-volumes of residual dispensed to waste during the post-clean. Range 0.0-20.0, 1 decimal, 0.5 step (executor post_dispense_needles). Enabled only when prep or clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Default 1 needle clears residual reagent/cells to waste.

settings.name: Intra-well retract [Settings, advanced]
settings.what_it_does: Short Z retract used for moves within one well. Range 0.0-20.0 mm, 2 decimals, 0.1 step (executor intra_well_retract_mm). Always applied.
settings.recommendation: Leave at default unless intra-well hops drag the needle.

settings.name: Z timeout [Settings, advanced]
settings.what_it_does: Z-move arrival timeout. Range 1.0-120.0 s, 0 decimals, 1 s step (executor z_timeout_s). Always applied.
settings.recommendation: Raise only if slow Z moves time out on your hardware.

settings.name: XY timeout [Settings, advanced]
settings.what_it_does: XY-move arrival timeout. Range 1.0-240.0 s, 0 decimals, 1 s step (executor xy_timeout_s). Always applied.
settings.recommendation: Raise only if long XY travels time out on your hardware.

settings.name: Locations & Hardware (read-only info section) [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Read-only summary of where all inks/reagents/service wells are, needle/syringe geometry, pump<->ink, calibrated Z heights and Safe Z, plus the selected cell-release reagent and its well. Rebuilt each time the popout is shown.
settings.recommendation: Glance here to confirm the reagent and service wells resolve before a run.

settings.name: Profile bar: Save / Save As / Delete / Import / Export / Reset + profile combo [Settings]
settings.what_it_does: Save, reload, delete, import/export, or reset named settings profiles for this workflow; the last-used set auto-restores when the page opens.
settings.recommendation: Save a profile per cell line/protocol so push/pull/dwell/heights are one click away.

safety_notes: The ZP (Z + pump) board MUST be connected before Start - the workflow needs it to retract the needle and run the pumps, and it refuses to start otherwise with an explicit status message.
If the ZP board drops mid-run, the executor's _safe_move_to raises AbortException (is_zp_connected check), stopping the run instead of dragging a lowered needle.

Every cross-position XY move (reagent well, removal target, placement, service wells, click-to-travel) routes through StageController.safe_travel_to, which retracts Z to Safe Z and waits for arrival before moving XY - the needle is never dragged across the plate while lowered.
On ANY exit (completion, abort, or error) the run's finally block raises the needle to Safe Z via ensure_retracted_to (raise-only, polarity-safe) - it never leaves the needle parked down in a well.

Start is blocked (with an explicit status message) unless: pick/place counts are balanced (>=1 pair), Safe Z is set, ZP is connected, plate bottom Z is calibrated (removal/place/reagent-dip + service-dip heights resolve), the push volume is positive (needle inner diameter set), the reagent has a calibrated well + dip Z, and - when prep/clean is on - the needle volume + all four service wells (waste/oil/wash/buffer) are assigned and calibrated.
Removal Z defaults to 0.10 mm above the plate bottom (just off the glass) - too small a value risks the tip contacting the bottom; verify the calibrated plate bottom is correct before running.

Click-to-travel in the XY Workspace with no Safe Z prompts (Yes/No, default No) before moving XY without retracting; right-click 'Fast travel here' refuses entirely without a Safe Z. Both require the XY stage connected.
Heights are resolved polarity-safe for ME3B V1 (needle descends as raw Z increases); a missing/uncalibrated plate bottom yields None and blocks the run rather than guessing.
tips: Pick i pairs with Place i by index, shown by the dashed connector on the live feed - the run truncates to the shorter list, but Start requires equal counts (is_balanced).

The push volume is computed as needle inner cross-section area x Push depth, so the same Push depth gives a different uL on a different bore - the live 'push X uL . pull Y uL' readout (4 decimals) reflects the actual needle.
The pump is volume-balanced per region (load - push - pull + dispense = 0) so it does not drift over a multi-region run.
Right-click near a marker on the live feed removes the nearest target within ~250 um - faster than the list buttons for one-offs.
Prep and clean each run only ONCE (before / after the whole loop), not per region - so the per-region time is dominated by the Dwell incubation.
Turn BOTH Prep and Clean off for a fast 'removal only' run when the needle is already conditioned; this also drops the service-well requirement at Start and disables the prep/clean sub-fields.
Use the XY Workspace click-to-travel or the Fluorescence overlay to confirm you are aiming at the right cells before committing to a run.

guides.title: Spheroid Pick & Place Workflow
guides.overview: This workflow aspirates spheroids one-at-a-time from source locations you click on the live microscope view and deposits each at a paired destination location. You click multiple "pick" points (green, P001…) and an equal number of "place" points (mauve, D001…) in the shared camera view; pick i is deposited at place i (paired by index, joined by a dashed connector line). For every pick/place pair the needle safe-travels to the source, lowers to the Pick Z, aspirates a volume computed from the spheroid diameter, raises and travels to the destination, lowers to the Place Z, and dispenses the same volume. An optional needle-conditioning PREP (waste → oil → wash → buffer) runs once before the loop and an optional post-clean (dispense → wash → buffer) runs once after. The needle always ends raised at the Safe Z on completion, abort, or error.
guides.where_to_find: Workflows mode → Workflow picker → "Spheroid Pick & Place" tile. (Backend page: gui/pages/workflows/spheroid_pickup_workflow.py, routed via workflows_mode.py.)
prerequisites: Hardware Setup completed: XY (Prior) stage AND ZP (Z + pump) board both connected. The Start gate refuses to run if the ZP board is not connected (it is needed to retract the needle before XY moves and to drive the aspirate/dispense pumps).

A microscope camera assigned to the MICROSCOPE role with a calibrated objective (microscope µm/px). Clicks in the live view are converted to stage µm using the objective calibration; without it the picker shows 'µm/px: —' and clicked targets will be mis-located.

Calibration page: a Safe Z (safe travel height) must be set, and the plate-bottom Z must be calibrated. Both are gated at Start: the Pick Z and Place Z offsets are heights above the calibrated plate bottom, so they cannot be resolved without it.
A pump/bore configured (the Pump/bore combo is populated from enabled + configured pumps; falls back to P1 if none are found).

If using PREP or post-clean: a configured needle with inner diameter + length set (Hardware Setup → Needle), so one 'needle' volume is known; and the waste / oil / wash / buffer service wells assigned in Hardware Setup → Ink (Reagent Locations) AND calibrated in the plate map. Prep needs all four (waste/oil/wash/buffer); post-clean needs waste/wash/buffer.

steps.title: Open the workflow
steps.detail: From Workflows mode, click the 'Spheroid Pick & Place' tile. The page shows the Live target picker (left), the XY Workspace and Side View (XZ) (right, in a vertical split), and a Start/Abort + status row at the bottom. The left context panel is the standard Jog panel (jog controls, shared with the Jog page; the connect controls are hidden here).

steps.title: Confirm the live view is calibrated
steps.detail: Check the 'µm/px:' readout at the top of the Live target picker. If it shows a number (optionally 'cal 0.xxx@W → live Wpx' when the live resolution differs from the calibration resolution), the click-to-stage transform is valid. If it shows '—', assign the microscope camera and select/calibrate its objective in Hardware Setup first.

steps.title: Set the spheroid size, bore and heights in Settings
steps.detail: Click '⚙ Settings' in the header. In 'Spheroid & bore' set Spheroid diameter (drives the aspirate/dispense volume), choose the Pump/bore, and adjust the Safety factor. The live 'V = … µL (×…)' readout shows the computed per-pick volume. In 'Heights (above plate bottom)' set Pick Z and Place Z. Optionally tune Flow rates and Pauses/dwell.

steps.title: Pick the source locations
steps.detail: With the Mode toggle ('Click adds to:') set to 'Pick' (default), left-click each spheroid in the live view. Each click adds a green marker (P001, P002, …) and a row to the Pick targets list. Right-click near a marker removes the nearest pick (within 250 µm); 'Remove selected' / 'Clear all' also edit the list.

steps.title: Pick the destination(s)
steps.detail: Switch the Mode toggle to 'Place', then left-click each deposit location (mauve markers D001, D002, …). A dashed connector line joins each pick to its paired place. You need exactly one place per pick — the pairing status reads '✓ N pick→place pair(s) ready.' (green) when balanced, or a peach '⚠ N pick(s) / M place(s) — counts must match' warning otherwise.

steps.title: Configure needle conditioning (optional)
steps.detail: In Settings, the 'Prep needle (waste → oil → wash → buffer)' checkbox (default ON) runs prep once before picking. Set Service dip Z, Prep flow, Oil/Buffer needle counts, and wash parameters. 'Clean after the run (dispense → wash → buffer)' (default OFF) runs once after the run. The prep status line shows '✓ 1 needle = … µL · waste=… oil=… wash=… buffer=…' when everything is assigned + calibrated, or a peach warning naming what is missing (needle geometry, unassigned wells, or uncalibrated plate bottom).

steps.title: Verify targets and stage position
steps.detail: The XY Workspace mirrors your picks (green) and places (mauve) as overlays and shows the live needle position (tracked ~5 Hz); the Side View (XZ) shows needle height with clickable Z-reference badges. Left-click the workspace to safe-travel the stage there (always retracts Z first); right-click for 'Fast travel here' (retract, travel, restore previous Z).

steps.title: Start the run
steps.detail: Click 'Start spheroid pickup'. It is enabled only when picks/places are balanced, a bore exists, and no run is in progress. At Start the page validates in order: balanced picks/places, Safe Z set, ZP connected, plate-bottom Z calibrated (resolves Pick Z + Place Z), and — if prep/clean is on — needle volume + required service wells + service dip Z. Status shows 'Running N spheroid pickup(s)…' then per-step messages. The needle conditions (if prep on), then for each pair: travel → lower to Pick Z → aspirate → (pause after pick) → travel → lower to Place Z → dispense → (pause after place).

steps.title: Monitor and abort if needed
steps.detail: Watch the status label for '[done/total] …' progress and per-operation sub-steps. Click 'Abort' (enabled only while running) to stop after the current sub-step. On completion, abort, or error the executor always retracts the needle to the Safe Z (raise-only), so it never parks down in a well. Final status reads 'Done.' or 'Stopped (aborted or failed).'

settings.name: ← Back to Workflows (header button)
settings.what_it_does: Returns to the Workflows picker.

settings.name: 🔬 Fluorescence (header checkbox)
settings.what_it_does: Overlays the captured fluorescence mosaic(s) for this plate (from the Fluorescence Mosaic workflow) onto the XY Workspace. If no mosaic exists for the plate it unticks itself and shows a status hint.
settings.recommendation: Turn on only after you have captured a fluorescence mosaic for this plate.

settings.name: ⚙ Settings (header button)
settings.what_it_does: Opens the full scrollable, saveable settings popout (Spheroid & bore, Heights, Flow rates, Pauses, Needle prep, Post-clean, Motion & timeouts, Locations). A one-line summary 'Ø…µm · pick …/place … µL/s · prep on/off' stays in the header.

settings.name: Live target picker — Mode toggle ('Click adds to:' Pick / Place radio)
settings.what_it_does: Routes the next left-click: Pick adds a green extraction target (P###); Place adds a mauve destination (D###). Right-click removes the nearest target of the active mode within 250 µm.
settings.recommendation: Add all picks first, then switch to Place and add one place per pick.

settings.name: Live target picker — Pick targets list + Clear all / Remove selected
settings.what_it_does: Lists pick targets with their pairing ('P001 → D001' or '(unpaired)') and stage µm coordinates. 'Clear all' empties the pick list; 'Remove selected' deletes highlighted rows.

settings.name: Live target picker — Place targets list + Clear all / Remove selected
settings.what_it_does: Lists place targets with their pairing and stage µm coordinates. 'Clear all' empties the place list; 'Remove selected' deletes highlighted rows.
settings.recommendation: Keep the place count equal to the pick count or Start stays disabled.

settings.name: XY Workspace — left-click (Travel here)
settings.what_it_does: Click-to-travel: safe-travels the stage to the clicked point. Always retracts Z to the Safe Z first via safe_travel_to (a near no-op if already retracted). If no Safe Z is set it asks before moving XY without retracting. No-op if the XY stage is not connected.
settings.recommendation: Use to position the live view over a region before picking.

settings.name: XY Workspace — right-click (Fast travel here)
settings.what_it_does: Retracts Z to Safe Z, travels XY, then restores the previous Z. Requires a Safe Z (warns and cancels if unset). No-op if the XY stage is not connected.

settings.name: Side View (XZ) — Z-reference badges
settings.what_it_does: Clicking a Z badge issues move_z_absolute to that zero-ref height. No-op when the ZP board is disconnected.

settings.name: Spheroid diameter (µm)
settings.what_it_does: Estimated spheroid diameter; sets the aspirate/dispense volume via V = (4/3)π(d/2)³ × safety factor (µm³ → µL). Shown live in the 'V = …' label.
settings.recommendation: Range 1–5000 µm (step 10). Set to your spheroid's measured diameter; volume scales with the cube of diameter.

settings.name: Pump / bore
settings.what_it_does: Which pump drives both the aspirate and the dispense. Populated from enabled + configured pumps in the hardware config; falls back to a single 'P1' entry if none are found.
settings.recommendation: Pick the pump connected to the needle bore you are using.

settings.name: Safety factor (×)
settings.what_it_does: Volume multiplier on the computed spheroid volume — aspirate a bit more than the bare spheroid volume so the spheroid is reliably captured.
settings.recommendation: Range 1.0–5.0 (step 0.1). 1.5 is a good start; increase if spheroids are missed.

settings.name: Pick Z (↑ bottom)
settings.what_it_does: Needle height above the calibrated plate bottom when aspirating at the source (pick_z_offset_mm). Resolved to a zero-ref Z via the plate-bottom datum.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–20 mm (step 0.05). Keep it just off the glass (~0.1 mm) to grab a settled spheroid.

settings.name: Place Z (↑ bottom)
settings.what_it_does: Needle height above the calibrated plate bottom when dispensing at the destination (place_z_offset_mm).
settings.recommendation: Range 0–20 mm (step 0.05). Usually higher than Pick Z so the spheroid is released cleanly.

settings.name: Pick (aspirate) flow (µL/s)
settings.what_it_does: Aspiration flow rate at the pick location (pickup_speed_uL_s). The pump command clamps to the safe flow limit internally.
settings.recommendation: Range 0.01–50 (step 0.1). Slower is gentler on fragile spheroids.

settings.name: Place (dispense) flow (µL/s)
settings.what_it_does: Dispense flow rate at the place location (release_speed_uL_s).
settings.recommendation: Range 0.01–50 (step 0.1).

settings.name: Pause after pick (s)
settings.what_it_does: Hold time after aspirating, so the spheroid settles into the bore (pick_dwell_s). 0 = no pause.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–3600 (step 0.5). Add a short hold (e.g. 1–2 s) if spheroids slip back out.

settings.name: Pause after place (s)
settings.what_it_does: Hold time after dispensing, so the spheroid releases from the bore (place_dwell_s). 0 = no pause.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–3600 (step 0.5).

settings.name: Prep needle (waste → oil → wash → buffer) (checkbox)
settings.what_it_does: Runs the needle-conditioning prep ONCE before the pick/place loop: dispense oil to waste, aspirate fresh oil, wash, aspirate buffer. Service-well locations are inherited from Hardware Setup → Ink (Reagent Locations).
settings.recommendation: Leave on for clean picks; turn off only for a quick bare pick/place test.

settings.name: Service dip Z (↑ bottom)
settings.what_it_does: Needle dip height above the plate bottom at the service wells during prep/clean (service_z_mm). Enabled when prep OR post-clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–30 mm (step 0.1). Enough to dip into reagent without touching glass.

settings.name: Prep flow (µL/s)
settings.what_it_does: Aspirate/dispense flow rate used throughout prep and post-clean (prep_rate_uL_s). Enabled when prep OR post-clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0.01–50 (step 0.1).

settings.name: Oil (needles)
settings.what_it_does: Number of needle-bore volumes of oil dispensed to waste AND aspirated from the oil well during prep (oil_needles). Prep-only — enabled only when prep is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–20 (step 0.5). 1 needle is typical.

settings.name: Buffer (needles)
settings.what_it_does: Number of needle-bore volumes of buffer aspirated after the wash (buffer_needles). Used by BOTH prep and post-clean; enabled when either is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–20 (step 0.5).

settings.name: Wash cycles
settings.what_it_does: Number of dip-jiggle cycles (Z jiggle + random XY about the well centre) at the wash well (wash_cycles). Used by prep and post-clean; enabled when either is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–50 (integer).

settings.name: Wash Z jiggle (mm)
settings.what_it_does: How far up/down each wash jiggle moves the needle (wash_z_amplitude_mm). The needle always returns to the exact dip Z with an absolute move so it can't walk toward the glass. Enabled when prep OR post-clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–10 mm (step 0.1).

settings.name: Wash XY jiggle (µm)
settings.what_it_does: Random XY radius about the wash well centre during the wash (wash_xy_amplitude_um). Enabled when prep OR post-clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–5000 µm (step 10).

settings.name: Wash settle (s)
settings.what_it_does: Settle time between wash jiggles (wash_dwell_s). Enabled when prep OR post-clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–30 s (step 0.1).

settings.name: Clean after the run (dispense → wash → buffer) (checkbox)
settings.what_it_does: Runs ONCE after the last place: dispense residual to waste, wash, reload buffer so the needle ends conditioned (do_post_clean).
settings.recommendation: Turn on to leave the needle clean and buffer-loaded after a run.

settings.name: Dispense (needles)
settings.what_it_does: Number of needle-bore volumes of residual dispensed to waste during post-clean (post_dispense_needles). Clean-only — enabled only when post-clean is on.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–20 (step 0.5).

settings.name: Intra-well retract (mm)
settings.what_it_does: Short Z retract used for moves that stay within the SAME named well (intra_well_retract_mm). Clicked spheroid points carry no well name, so every move here uses the full safe-Z travel instead — this rarely applies. Always applied to the executor.
settings.recommendation: Range 0–20 mm (step 0.1). Leave at default.

settings.name: Z timeout (s)
settings.what_it_does: Maximum time to wait for a Z move to reach its target before timing out (z_timeout_s). Always applied.
settings.recommendation: Range 1–120 s. Increase only if Z moves legitimately take longer.

settings.name: XY timeout (s)
settings.what_it_does: Maximum time to wait for an XY move to arrive before timing out (xy_timeout_s). Always applied.
settings.recommendation: Range 1–240 s.

settings.name: Locations & Hardware (read-only info section)
settings.what_it_does: Read-only panel showing where all inks/reagents/service wells are, needle/syringe geometry, pump↔ink mapping, and calibrated Z heights. Rebuilt each time the popout is shown.
settings.recommendation: Use it to confirm the prep service wells are assigned and calibrated before running.

settings.name: Settings profile bar (Save / Save As… / Delete / Import… / Export… / Reset + profile combo)
settings.what_it_does: Saves, loads, deletes, imports and exports named setting profiles for this workflow; last-used values auto-restore when the page opens. Reset returns fields to defaults.
settings.recommendation: Save a named profile per spheroid type / plate so you can reload tuned settings.

settings.name: Start spheroid pickup (button)
settings.what_it_does: Validates the Start gate and launches the run on a worker thread. Enabled only when picks/places are balanced, a bore exists, and no run is in progress.

settings.name: Abort (button)
settings.what_it_does: Sets the executor abort flag; the run stops after the current sub-step and the needle is retracted to Safe Z. Enabled only while a run is in progress.

safety_notes: Every cross-position move retracts Z to the Safe Z BEFORE moving XY (via safe_travel_to). Clicked spheroid targets have no well name, so they always use the full safe-Z travel — they are never treated as intra-well 1 mm hops.

The ZP (Z + pump) board is REQUIRED. Start refuses to run if it is disconnected, and mid-run _safe_move_to raises an abort if the ZP board drops, so the stage never drags an unretracted needle across the plate.

On ANY exit (completion, abort, or error) the executor retracts the needle to the Safe Z via ensure_retracted_to (raise-only, polarity-safe). The needle never stays parked down in a well at the Place Z.

Start is gated, in order, on: balanced picks/places, a bore present, Safe Z configured, ZP connected, and a calibrated plate-bottom Z (needed to resolve Pick Z / Place Z). If prep or post-clean is on, it additionally requires a needle inner diameter + length and the required service wells (prep: waste/oil/wash/buffer; clean: waste/wash/buffer) assigned AND calibrated, plus a resolvable service dip Z — otherwise it shows a status message and refuses to start.

If no Safe Z is set and you left-click the XY workspace, the app asks before moving XY without retracting Z — declining cancels the move. Right-click 'Fast travel' simply refuses (warns) when no Safe Z is set.
During the wash, the needle returns to the exact dip Z with an absolute move so a soft-limit-clamped lift cannot walk the tip toward the glass over repeated cycles.
Pick Z and Place Z are heights above the calibrated plate bottom; a wrong plate-bottom calibration directly changes how close the needle gets to the glass.
tips: Pair order matters: pick i goes to place i. Add picks in the order you want them deposited, then add the matching places in the same order. The dashed connector lines on the camera view confirm the pairing.
The aspirate/dispense volume scales with diameter cubed — small changes in Spheroid diameter make large volume changes. Watch the live 'V = … µL' readout in Settings.
The same volume is aspirated and dispensed per pair, so the pump stays net-balanced across a pick/place.
Save a Settings profile per spheroid type so flow rates, Pick/Place Z, and prep counts reload instantly next session; the last-used values also auto-restore when you reopen the page.
The XY Workspace and Side View are the same widgets as the Jog page and track the live stage at ~5 Hz; use the workspace click-to-travel to scout regions before clicking picks in the camera view.
If the picker µm/px reads '—', clicks will be mis-located — fix the microscope objective calibration in Hardware Setup before picking.
