guides.title: Cell Staining (Cell Labeling) Workflow
guides.overview: Cell Labeling is a stain-in-place workflow: you click one or more regions to stain on the live microscope view, pick a stain reagent, and the machine — for each region — loads the stain from its reagent well, lowers just off the plate bottom, SLOWLY deposits a tiny stain column, waits a user-set incubation time (the headline knob), SLOWLY aspirates a multiple of that volume back up, then travels to the waste well and dispenses it. There is NO placement target (unlike Cell Targeting & Removal); the picker runs in "pick_only" mode so you only ever select regions to stain. An optional needle prep brackets the start (waste → oil → wash → buffer) and an optional clean runs at the end (waste → wash → buffer). The waste dump is always part of the operation, so a calibrated waste well is required even with prep/clean off. The pump is volume-balanced per region (load − deposit − aspirate + waste-dispense = 0) so it never drifts.
guides.where_to_find: Main sidebar → Workflows → workflow picker → Cell Labeling tile (id: cell_labeling). Opens the Cell Labeling page: header row (Back, title, "Pick = regions to stain", a settings summary label, 🔬 Fluorescence checkbox, ⚙ Settings button); a horizontal split with the live picker on the LEFT and a vertical split on the RIGHT holding the XY Workspace (top) over the Side View (XZ) (bottom); and a Start staining / Abort / status run row at the bottom.
prerequisites: Hardware connected: both XY stage AND the ZP (Z + pump) board. The ZP board is required to retract the needle and run the pumps — Start refuses without it.
Plate calibrated on the Calibration page: a calibrated plate-bottom Z (so the label height, stain dip Z, and service/waste dip Z can each be resolved) and a Safe Z (move/travel height).
A Safe Z configured (Calibration page). Without it, Start refuses; a left-click on the XY Workspace then prompts you before traveling without retracting Z, and right-click Fast travel is blocked.

Needle geometry set in Hardware Setup → Needle: inner diameter (its cross-section area drives the deposit volume), plus length if using prep/clean (the prep 'needle volume' uses area × length). A zero/unknown bore gives zero deposit volume and blocks Start.

Stain reagent assigned a reagent location in Hardware Setup → Ink → Reagent Locations, AND that well present in the calibrated plate (run Plate Location). Only library inks that have a reagent location AND are NOT service reagents (oil/wash/waste/buffer, by ink_type or by name) appear in the combo.
A waste well assigned + calibrated (Hardware Setup → Ink → Reagent Locations) — ALWAYS required; the recovered stain is dumped there after every region, independent of prep/clean.
If using needle prep and/or clean after: oil, wash, and buffer service wells must also be assigned + calibrated, and the needle inner Ø + length must be set.

steps.title: Open the workflow
steps.detail: Go to Workflows and click the Cell Labeling tile. The header reads 'Cell Labeling' (blue) with the hint 'Pick = regions to stain' and a one-line settings summary. The left pane is the live microscope picker; the right pane stacks the XY Workspace (top, ~3:2 stretch) over the Side View (XZ, bottom).

steps.title: Open Settings and set the stain reagent + pump
steps.detail: Click the ⚙ Settings button (top-right) to open the scrollable, saveable popout. In the 'Pump & stain reagent' section, choose the Pump / bore (P1/P2/P3, populated from enabled + configured pumps; falls back to P1) and the Stain reagent combo. Set 'Stain dip Z (↑ bottom)' (default 0.50 mm). The status line shows '✓ Stain "X" ← <well> · load ~N µL on the <bore> bore' when resolved, or a peach ⚠ if no stain is selected, the stain has no reagent location, or its well isn't in the calibrated plate.

steps.title: Set the headline incubation time
steps.detail: In the 'Stain incubation' section, set 'Stain time (incubation)' (default 300 s, range 0–14400 s, 15 s steps). This is how long the stain develops on the cells before it is aspirated back off — the central knob of this workflow. The hint below reads '= <Ns/m/h> of incubation per region.'

steps.title: Set the region height
steps.detail: In 'Region height' set 'Label Z (↑ bottom)' (default 0.10 mm, range 0–20 mm) — the needle height above the plate bottom at each stain region. Keep small (just off the bottom); it is resolved polarity-safely to a zero-ref Z and pushed as the executor's label height.

steps.title: Tune deposit / aspirate mechanics (optional)
steps.detail: In 'Stain deposit / removal' set Deposit depth (default 0.10 mm → deposit volume = needle inner area × depth), Aspirate (×) multiplier (default 2.0), and the two SLOW flows: Deposit flow (default 0.5 µL/s, also used for the waste dispense) and Aspirate flow (default 0.5 µL/s, used to load AND to aspirate the stain back off). The 'V = …' readout shows the resolved deposit and aspirate µL, or 'V = — (set needle inner Ø)' if no bore area is configured.

steps.title: Configure prep / clean (optional) and confirm the waste well
steps.detail: In 'Needle prep / clean' leave 'Prep needle (waste → oil → wash → buffer)' and 'Clean after (waste → wash → buffer)' on (defaults) or turn them off. Note 'Service / waste dip Z (↑ bottom)' (default 0.50 mm) stays ACTIVE even when prep/clean are off, because the post-incubation waste dump always needs it. The prep status shows '✓ 1 needle = N µL · oil=… wash=… waste=… buffer=…' when service wells resolve, a 'Prep + clean disabled — staining only (waste=…)' note when both are off, or a peach ⚠ telling you exactly what to assign/calibrate.

steps.title: Pick regions to stain
steps.detail: On the live picker (left), click each spot you want to stain. The picker is in pick_only mode: there is no Place section and no Mode toggle — every click adds a region. The status shows '✓ N region(s) selected.' Use 'Clear all' or 'Remove selected' to edit. Selected regions appear as green overlay dots on the XY Workspace.

steps.title: Verify positions on the workspace
steps.detail: Confirm the green region dots, the needle position, and the plate orientation in the XY Workspace. Optionally toggle '🔬 Fluorescence' (header) to overlay a previously-captured fluorescence mosaic for this plate. Use the Side View (XZ) green 'Safe' badge (or other Z-reference badges) to send the needle to a safe Z before any manual repositioning.

steps.title: Start staining
steps.detail: Click 'Start staining'. The button is enabled only when ≥1 region is selected and a bore exists (and not while a run is active). On click the page runs all the Start gates in order: ≥1 region; Safe Z set; ZP connected; plate-bottom calibrated (label Z resolves); deposit volume > 0 (needle inner Ø set); a stain reagent selected with a calibrated reagent well and resolvable dip Z; a calibrated waste well with resolvable service/waste dip Z; and — if prep or clean is on — needle inner Ø + length and the oil/wash/buffer wells. Any failure shows the reason in the status line and aborts before motion. When all pass the status reads 'Staining N region(s)…' and the run starts on a daemon thread.

steps.title: Monitor and (if needed) abort
steps.detail: The status line shows [done/total] progress and per-region sub-steps: 'Loading … µL of stain', 'Moving to stain region …', 'Depositing … (slow)', 'Stain incubation', 'Aspirating … (slow)', 'Moving to waste', 'Dispensing … to waste', then 'Complete'. Click 'Abort' to request a stop; it sets the abort flag and the executor stops at the next safe checkpoint and retracts to Safe Z. On finish the status reads 'Done.' or 'Stopped (aborted or failed).'

settings.name: ← Back to Workflows (header button)
settings.what_it_does: Returns to the workflow picker (emits back_requested).
settings.recommendation: Use when finished or to switch workflows.

settings.name: 🔬 Fluorescence (header checkbox)
settings.what_it_does: Overlays the captured fluorescence mosaic(s) for this plate (from the Fluorescence Mosaic workflow) onto the XY Workspace. If no mosaic exists for the plate it un-checks itself and the status line says to run the Fluorescence Mosaic workflow first.
settings.recommendation: Turn on to line up stain regions with previously imaged fluorescence; purely a visual aid.

settings.name: ⚙ Settings (header button)
settings.what_it_does: Opens the full, scrollable, saveable settings popout (stain reagent, incubation time, deposit/aspirate, prep/clean, motion/timeouts, locations). The popout is a persistent modeless child window, hidden when you leave the page.
settings.recommendation: Open this first to set the stain, incubation time, and Z heights.

settings.name: Settings summary (header label)
settings.what_it_does: Read-only one-line summary mirroring the popout: 'stain <time> · deposit X/aspirate Y µL · prep on/off'.
settings.recommendation: Glance here to confirm key settings without opening the popout.

settings.name: Live target picker (left pane)
settings.what_it_does: Microscope live view + region list. In pick_only mode: no Place section, no Mode toggle — every click adds a region to stain. Shows '✓ N region(s) selected.' with green list entries; clicks map to stage µm via the calibrated objective µm/px.
settings.recommendation: Click each spot to stain. Picks drive the green dots on the XY Workspace.

settings.name: Clear all (picker button)
settings.what_it_does: Removes all selected regions.
settings.recommendation: Use to start the region list over.

settings.name: Remove selected (picker button)
settings.what_it_does: Removes the highlighted region(s) from the list.
settings.recommendation: Use to drop a single mis-clicked region.

settings.name: XY Workspace (right, top)
settings.what_it_does: Top-down plate view showing wells, the live needle position, and the selected regions as green pick overlays. Left-click = click-to-travel (always retracts via safe_travel_to when a Safe Z is set; if no Safe Z, prompts before a no-retract move). Right-click = 'Fast travel here' (retract Z, travel XY, restore the current Z; requires a Safe Z). No-op when XY is disconnected.
settings.recommendation: Use to confirm region placement and to jog the stage to a spot before staining.

settings.name: Side View (XZ) (right, bottom)
settings.what_it_does: Side profile showing the needle Z vs. the plate and Z reference heights. The green 'Safe' badge (and other Z-reference badges) emit a go-to-Z request → moves the needle to that zero-ref Z via move_z_absolute (no-op if ZP disconnected).
settings.recommendation: Use the Safe badge to retract the needle before manual repositioning.

settings.name: Start staining (run-row button)
settings.what_it_does: Validates all Start gates and, if they pass, queues one CELL_LABELING operation per region and runs the executor on a daemon thread. Enabled only when ≥1 region is selected and a bore exists, and not while a run is active.
settings.recommendation: If it stays idle on click, read the status line — it names the gate that failed.

settings.name: Abort (run-row button)
settings.what_it_does: Sets the executor abort flag. Enabled only while a run is active; the executor stops at the next safe checkpoint and retracts to Safe Z (it does NOT halt motion mid-step).
settings.recommendation: Use to stop a run; expect it to finish the current safe step first.

settings.name: Status line (run row)
settings.what_it_does: Shows idle/progress text: gate-failure reasons, [done/total] progress, per-region sub-steps, and the final 'Done.' / 'Stopped (aborted or failed).'
settings.recommendation: Your primary feedback channel during a run.

settings.name: Stain time (incubation) — popout 'Stain incubation'
settings.what_it_does: Headline knob: how long the stain develops on the cells before it is aspirated back off. QDoubleSpinBox, range 0–14400 s, step 15 s, 0 decimals. Maps to CellLabelingConfig.stain_dwell_time_s; the executor dwells this long per region after deposit. A hint below shows it formatted (s/m/h).
settings.recommendation: Set to your stain protocol's incubation time.

settings.name: Label Z (↑ bottom) — popout 'Region height'
settings.what_it_does: Needle height above the plate bottom at the stain region. Range 0–20 mm, step 0.05, 2 decimals. Resolved polarity-safely to a zero-ref Z and pushed as the executor's pick_z_mm (reused as the label height). Maps to label_z_offset_mm.
settings.recommendation: Keep small (just off the bottom) so the stain lands on the cells; don't drive into the glass.

settings.name: Pump / bore — popout 'Pump & stain reagent'
settings.what_it_does: Which pump/bore holds and dispenses the stain. Populated from enabled + configured pumps (P1/P2/P3); falls back to 'P1' if none. Maps to stain_bore. Changing it re-filters the reagent combo (defaults to that bore's assigned ink if present).
settings.recommendation: Pick the bore physically loaded with the stain syringe.

settings.name: Stain reagent — popout 'Pump & stain reagent'
settings.what_it_does: The stain the needle loads. Lists '(none — needle already loaded)' plus library inks that have a reagent location AND are NOT service reagents (oil/wash/waste/buffer, by ink_type or name). The status line shows the resolved well + load volume or a ⚠.
settings.default: the selected bore's assigned ink if it appears in the list, else '(none — needle already loaded)'
settings.recommendation: Choose your dye/stain; if it's missing, assign it a reagent location in Hardware Setup → Ink and calibrate that well (Plate Location).

settings.name: Stain dip Z (↑ bottom) — popout 'Pump & stain reagent'
settings.what_it_does: Needle dip height above the plate bottom when aspirating the stain from its reagent well. Range 0–30 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Pushed as the executor's reagent_dip_z_mm.
settings.recommendation: Set so the tip dips into the stain reservoir without bottoming out.

settings.name: Deposit depth — popout 'Stain deposit / removal'
settings.what_it_does: Sets the deposited stain column: deposit volume = needle inner cross-section area × this depth (1 mm³ = 1 µL). Range 0.001–5.0 mm, step 0.05, 3 decimals. Maps to deposit_depth_mm; updates the V= readout.
settings.recommendation: Keep tiny so a small amount relative to the needle bore is delivered.

settings.name: Aspirate (×) — popout 'Stain deposit / removal'
settings.what_it_does: Stain-removal volume = this multiple × the deposited volume (stain plus a little surrounding fluid). Range 1.0–20.0, step 0.5, 2 decimals. Maps to aspirate_multiplier.
settings.recommendation: 2× recovers the deposited stain plus excess; raise to pull more surrounding fluid.

settings.name: Deposit flow (slow) — popout 'Stain deposit / removal'
settings.what_it_does: SLOW flow rate used to deposit the stain — also used for the final waste dispense. Range 0.01–50 µL/s, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Maps to deposit_speed_uL_s.
settings.recommendation: Keep slow so the stain is delivered gently onto the cells.

settings.name: Aspirate flow (slow) — popout 'Stain deposit / removal'
settings.what_it_does: SLOW flow rate used to load the stain from its well AND to aspirate it back off. Range 0.01–50 µL/s, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Maps to aspirate_speed_uL_s.
settings.recommendation: Keep slow so the stain is withdrawn gently without disturbing cells.

settings.name: V = … readout — popout 'Stain deposit / removal'
settings.what_it_does: Read-only: shows 'deposit X µL · aspirate Y µL' from needle area × depth × multiplier, or 'V = — (set needle inner Ø)' when no bore area is configured.
settings.recommendation: Confirm a sane volume; if it says set needle inner Ø, fix Hardware Setup → Needle.

settings.name: Prep needle (waste → oil → wash → buffer) — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Checkbox; when on, runs the conditioning prep once before the region loop: dispense oil to waste, draw fresh oil, wash, draw buffer. Maps to executor.do_prep. Toggling it enables/disables the prep parameter spinboxes (except the service/waste dip Z).
settings.recommendation: Leave on for a clean needle; turn off if you've already conditioned it (then oil/wash/buffer wells aren't required, but the waste well still is).

settings.name: Clean after (waste → wash → buffer) — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Checkbox; when on, runs a clean once after the region loop. Maps to executor.do_post_clean. Shares the prep parameter enable state.
settings.recommendation: Leave on to leave the needle clean; turn off to skip the end-of-run clean.

settings.name: Service / waste dip Z (↑ bottom) — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Needle dip height above the plate bottom at the service wells AND the always-required post-incubation waste dump. Range 0–30 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Deliberately NOT disabled when prep/clean are off — the waste dump always needs it. Pushed as executor.service_z_mm.
settings.recommendation: Set so the tip dips into the service/waste wells without bottoming out.

settings.name: Prep / clean flow — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Aspirate/dispense flow rate during prep and clean steps. Range 0.01–50 µL/s, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Disabled unless prep or clean is on. Maps to prep_rate_uL_s.
settings.recommendation: Default is fine; only used during conditioning, not deposition.

settings.name: Oil (needles) — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Needles of oil dispensed to waste then aspirated from the oil well during prep. Range 0–20, step 0.5, 1 decimal. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to oil_needles.
settings.recommendation: 1 needle is the standard oil refresh.

settings.name: Buffer (needles) — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Needles of buffer drawn after the wash during prep. Range 0–20, step 0.5, 1 decimal. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to buffer_needles.
settings.recommendation: Default 4; raise to fill more buffer behind the stain.

settings.name: Wash cycles — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Number of dip-jiggle cycles at the wash well. QSpinBox 0–50. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to wash_cycles.
settings.recommendation: More cycles = more thorough wash.

settings.name: Wash Z jiggle — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: How far up/down each wash jiggle moves. Range 0–10 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to wash_z_amplitude_mm.
settings.recommendation: Default is fine; keep within the well depth.

settings.name: Wash XY jiggle — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Random XY radius about the wash well centre during washing. Range 0–5000 µm, step 10, 0 decimals. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to wash_xy_amplitude_um.
settings.recommendation: Keep inside the wash well radius.

settings.name: Wash settle — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Settle/dwell time between wash jiggles. Range 0–30 s, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to wash_dwell_s.
settings.recommendation: Default is fine.

settings.name: Clean dispense (needles) — popout 'Needle prep / clean'
settings.what_it_does: Needles of residual dispensed to waste during the post-clean. Range 0–20, step 0.5, 1 decimal. Disabled unless prep/clean on. Maps to post_dispense_needles.
settings.recommendation: Default is fine.

settings.name: Intra-well retract — popout 'Motion & timeouts (advanced)'
settings.what_it_does: Short Z retract distance used for moves within one well. Range 0–20 mm, step 0.1, 2 decimals. Always applied. Maps to executor.intra_well_retract_mm.
settings.recommendation: Leave default unless you see the needle dragging within a well.

settings.name: Z timeout — popout 'Motion & timeouts (advanced)'
settings.what_it_does: How long to wait for a Z move to arrive before reporting a timeout. Range 1–120 s, step 1, 0 decimals. Maps to executor.z_timeout_s.
settings.recommendation: Raise only if Z moves are legitimately slow.

settings.name: XY timeout — popout 'Motion & timeouts (advanced)'
settings.what_it_does: How long to wait for an XY move to arrive before reporting a timeout. Range 1–240 s, step 1, 0 decimals. Maps to executor.xy_timeout_s.
settings.recommendation: Raise only for long plate-spanning travels.

settings.name: Locations & Hardware (read-only info section) — popout
settings.what_it_does: Read-only panel rebuilt on show: shows where inks/reagents/service wells are, needle/syringe geometry, pump↔ink mapping, and calibrated Z heights, plus an extra 'Stain reagent: <name> ← <well>' line for the currently selected stain.
settings.recommendation: Use to verify the stain well, waste well, and Z references resolve before starting.

settings.name: Profile bar (Save / Save As… / Delete / Import… / Export… / Reset + profile combo) — popout
settings.what_it_does: Standard WorkflowSettingsDialog profile controls: save the current settings as a named profile, reload, delete, import/export a file, or reset to defaults. The last-used settings auto-restore on open (load_last), and pending hardware-populated combo selections (bore/reagent) resolve once the combos populate.
settings.recommendation: Save a named profile per stain protocol so you can reload its incubation time, multiplier, and slow flows in one click.

safety_notes: The ZP (Z + pump) board MUST be connected — Start refuses if not, because staining needs it to retract the needle and run the pumps.
A Safe Z must be configured (Calibration page). Without it Start refuses; on the XY Workspace a left-click then prompts before traveling without retracting Z, and right-click Fast travel is blocked.

Plate-bottom Z must be calibrated — all heights (label Z, stain dip Z, service/waste dip Z) are 'above plate bottom' and are resolved polarity-safely; if uncalibrated, Start aborts with a message instead of moving.

Cross-position click-to-travel and all inter-region/inter-well executor moves retract the needle via safe_travel_to (a near-no-op when already retracted), so the needle is not dragged across the plate.

The waste well is ALWAYS required — the recovered stain is dumped there after every region. The service/waste dip Z stays enabled even with prep/clean off for this reason, and Start refuses without a calibrated waste well + resolvable dip Z.
The deposit volume must be > 0 — Start refuses if the needle inner diameter (bore area) is not set, since deposit = area × depth.
If prep or clean is enabled, Start additionally requires the needle inner Ø + length (the 'needle volume') and calibrated oil/wash/buffer wells, or it tells you to turn prep/clean off.
The pump is volume-balanced per region (load − deposit − aspirate + waste-dispense = 0), so it does not drift over a run.
Abort does not stop motion instantly: it sets a flag and the executor stops at the next checkpoint, then retracts to Safe Z. On any finish/abort/failure the run ends and the button state resets.
Keep Label Z and the dip Z heights small but above zero so the needle stays just off the glass; an overly small/incorrect height risks contacting the plate bottom.
tips: Open ⚙ Settings first — set the stain reagent, pump, incubation time, and Z heights before picking regions. The header summary and the popout status lines tell you what's still missing.

The reagent combo only shows printable library inks that have a reagent location; service reagents (oil/wash/waste/buffer) are intentionally excluded. If your stain is missing, assign it a location in Hardware Setup → Ink and run Plate Location.
Watch the popout status lines: a green '✓' means the stain/well/service wells resolved; a peach '⚠' tells you exactly what to assign or calibrate.
Deposit volume is computed from the needle bore (area × deposit depth). If the V= readout shows '—', set the needle inner diameter in Hardware Setup → Needle.
Turn prep/clean off to stain only — but you still need a calibrated waste well, since the post-incubation dump is core to the operation.
Both the deposit and aspirate flows are intentionally slow (0.5 µL/s default) so the stain is delivered and withdrawn gently — only change them if your protocol needs it.
Use the '🔬 Fluorescence' overlay to align stain regions with a previously captured fluorescence mosaic of the same plate.
Save a named settings profile per stain protocol so the incubation time, multiplier, and slow flows reload in one click.
